text.arabic_uthmani: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌۭ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌۭ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

words.gloss_range: resumptive coordination that joins Sulayman to the prior prophet-favor sequence without forcing chronology
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes rather than merely starts. It joins Sulayman's grant to the preceding Dawud unit as another divine favor, so the wind scene is heard inside a continuing register of bestowed, accountable capacity rather than as a detached royal legend.

topics.headline: resumptive prophet-favor link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Sulayman’s powers enter as another coordinated divine favor, not as an isolated marvel.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the new unit with the prior prophet-favor material while leaving chronology open.

words.gloss_range: fronted beneficiary/allocation lām governing the opening grant frame
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) places assignment before the force being assigned. By fronting the beneficiary relation, the ayah makes service and special allocation govern the listener's hearing before the wind appears, while the accusative wind lets the act of subjection remain compressed behind the opening frame.

topics.headline: beneficiary frame before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grant first as allocation for Sulayman, before the wind is even named.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase licenses a benefit/allocation frame and the following accusative supports an elided subjection reading.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name integrated as the administrative recipient of the grant
words.prose: {{ar:سُلَيْمَٰنَ}} ({{tr:sulaymāna}}) is the named administrative axis of the catalog: wind, copper, and jinn labor are arranged around him, while later divine first-person forms and the Lordship phrase keep him from becoming the ultimate source. Its diptote ending after the prefixed lām is case behavior of the proper name, not object marking; the s-l-m resonance may color ordered submission but does not make the name a common Arabic noun.

topics.headline: named recipient under higher authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks Sulayman as the local center of administration while the ayah keeps final authority with God.
topics.reason: The proper name is grammatically integrated into the lām frame and then carried by suffixes, while lordship and divine agency qualify his role.

words.gloss_range: definite governed wind, locally measured as commanded transport force
words.root_gloss_range: wind/breath/relief field; locally selected as governed wind, with accepted readings showing case and number pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرِّيحَ}} ({{tr:al-rīḥa}}) is an invisible force made administratively measurable. The accusative surface points to a compressed subjection frame after the fronted beneficiary phrase, and the definite singular gathers the wind into one governed transport force. Variant readings can expose nominative-topic or plural-winds pressure, but the local surface keeps object-like subjection and the month-pair turns air into scheduled reach with balanced outward and return measures.

topics.headline: governed wind made measurable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wind is not just fast weather; it is a governed transport architecture measured by repeated month units.
topics.reason: The rows coherently point to compressed subjection, wind/breath pressure, variant case-number contrasts, and local measurement; the variants qualify rather than replace the surface parse.

words.gloss_range: wind’s morning-going as first measured route leg
words.root_gloss_range: early-going field selected as route-stage rather than mere time of day
words.prose: {{ar:غُدُوُّهَا}} ({{tr:ghuduwwuhā}}) makes the morning course belong to the wind through its feminine suffix. As a verbal noun subject with the month predicate as predicate, it turns daybreak movement into a standing capacity: the first leg of a two-part itinerary, not a one-time trip or a bare morning label.

topics.headline: first measured route leg
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the morning as a measured transport leg owned by the wind, not just a time stamp.
topics.reason: The suffix, verbal-noun form, and nominal equation all support a stable morning route-stage that anticipates the return leg.

words.gloss_range: indefinite month predicate used as public measure of reach
words.root_gloss_range: publicly recognized month/time field redeployed as distance-scale
words.prose: The first {{ar:شَهْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:shahrun}}) predicates scale rather than naming a travel object. Its indefinite nominative form gives a generic, repeatable month-measure, so the morning course is calibrated through public time instead of technical geography or vague wonder.

topics.headline: public month as reach measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary calendrical time is repurposed to make miraculous reach countable.
topics.reason: The nominative predicate and repeated month structure make the term a scale measure, not an object or a named calendar month.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that gives the return course equal syntactic weight
words.prose: The middle {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens a second full nominal equation. It coordinates the return course with the morning course without subordination, so the itinerary has two balanced legs rather than one stated leg plus an implied remainder.

topics.headline: equal coordination of route legs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the return leg receives equal grammatical weight in the measured itinerary.
topics.reason: The conjunction heads a parallel subject-predicate unit and preserves equal weight for the second route measure.

words.gloss_range: wind’s evening/return-going as second measured route leg
words.root_gloss_range: return/late-day movement field tied back to the same wind
words.prose: {{ar:رَوَاحُهَا}} ({{tr:rawāḥuhā}}) mirrors the morning course as a second verbal-noun subject, and its suffix sends the reader back to the same governed wind. The root reprise shifts from the wind itself to its late-day or return course, completing a daily rhythm of outward and return movement at the same scale.

topics.headline: return leg completes itinerary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind’s service as rhythmic and cyclical, with the return course measured on its own terms.
topics.reason: The mirrored subject form, suffix, and r-w-ḥ reprise all support an independently measured return leg.

words.gloss_range: repeated month predicate closing the wind subsection with symmetrical measure
words.root_gloss_range: public month unit repeated as measured refrain
words.prose: The second {{ar:شَهْرٌۭ}} ({{tr:shahrun}}) is stated rather than left to ellipsis. Its repetition gives the return course its own public measure and closes the wind subsection with balanced accounting before the ayah shifts from air to molten metal.

topics.headline: second month closes measured wind unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the marvel as symmetrical reckoning, not loose hyperbole about speed.
topics.reason: The repeated indefinite nominative predicate independently measures the return leg and forms a short refrain with the first month term.

words.gloss_range: coordinating pivot from measured air movement to material flow
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds another divine act without forcing a timeline. It keeps the catalog rhythm while shifting domains from measured wind-transport to molten material supply, so the ayah expands power across force and matter under the same provisioning frame.

topics.headline: catalog pivot to material supply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah widen from controlled motion to controlled material without leaving the grant catalog.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates a fresh divine act and marks a domain shift while preserving the enumerative grant structure.

words.gloss_range: Form IV caused-flow of copper spring as completed divine enabling
words.root_gloss_range: torrent/flow field selected causatively for molten metal
words.prose: {{ar:أَسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:asalnā}}) makes the copper supply a caused flow, not a naturally available resource. The perfect first-person plural marks completed divine enabling, while the s-y-l torrent field makes metal behave like a controlled stream from a source, moving the catalog from transport to industrial provision.

topics.headline: divinely caused molten flow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that metal is not merely given; it is made to flow like a managed spring.
topics.reason: Form IV, first-person plural, and the object phrase support a causative divine act applied to a copper source.

words.gloss_range: beneficiary pronoun reattaching copper flow to the Sulayman grant frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) carries Sulayman into the copper clause without renaming him. The repeated lām relation links air and metal as assigned service for him, while still presenting the flow itself as caused by the divine speaker.

topics.headline: same beneficiary across air and metal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one beneficiary relation across the domain shift from wind to copper.
topics.reason: The lām plus 3MS suffix resumes Sulayman and repeats the allocation frame established at the opening.

words.gloss_range: singular construct source of molten copper, selected as spring/aperture under flow verb
words.root_gloss_range: eye/source/spring field narrowed to source-spring with visibility pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عَيْنَ}} ({{tr:ʿayna}}) is the object of the caused-flow verb and the construct head of the copper term, so it names one focused copper-source. The flow verb selects the spring sense, while the eye/source field keeps the image visible and aperture-like: provision emerges from a concentrated outlet rather than from diffuse mineral abundance.

topics.headline: focused copper spring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a visible source of provision, not just a store of metal.
topics.reason: The construct grammar makes one source phrase, and the flow context narrows the broad eye/spring/source range toward a spring-like outlet.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive copper substance made fluid in the spring image
words.root_gloss_range: dripping/copper field narrowed to molten copper in construct with spring and flow
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقِطْرِ}} ({{tr:al-qiṭri}}) specifies the substance of the spring. The q-ṭ-r field may touch dripping, pitch, region, and copper, but the construct with the spring term and the caused-flow verb narrows the local sense to molten copper: a known material made fluid and usable rather than static ore.

topics.headline: molten copper as spring substance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wonder as technological material supply: copper itself flows from a source.
topics.reason: The genitive construct specifies substance, while the spring and flow context select molten copper over broader q-ṭ-r branches.

words.gloss_range: coordinating pivot from natural/material grants to hidden labor and warning
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the catalog moving but opens a new participant scene. After air and metal, it brings hidden labor into the same sequence, and the ayah's repeated coordinators will soon turn the grant rhythm into a liability frame.

topics.headline: catalog expands to hidden labor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the catalog widen from forces and materials to accountable workers.
topics.reason: The conjunction both coordinates the next unit and introduces a fresh class of participants under supervision.

words.gloss_range: partitive source phrase selecting some from the jinn class
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) makes the labor claim partitive. The workers are drawn from the jinn class, not equated with all jinn, and the class source is heard before the relative pronoun defines their function.

topics.headline: subset from the jinn class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids totalizing the claim: the ayah speaks of a working subset from the jinn.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following class noun and creates a partitive source phrase before the worker relative.

words.gloss_range: definite hidden class converted into accountable workforce
words.root_gloss_range: concealment/coveredness field locally placed in supervised service
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِنِّ}} ({{tr:al-jinni}}) names a known hidden class, but the construction does not pause on ontology. Through the partitive-relative frame, hidden beings become a selected workforce; through the presence phrase they are placed in accountable presence, and through permission and command they remain inside divine governance.

topics.headline: hidden class made accountable workforce
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices concealed beings being made visible in function: workers before authority, under permission, and liable to command.
topics.reason: The definite class noun, partitive construction, location phrase, and authorization frame together convert hidden ontology into supervised labor.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun identifying workers before later conditional liability
words.prose: The first {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) is relative, not conditional. It identifies the ones who work from within the partitive jinn group, while the later {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) will distribute liability over any deviator; the same surface pronoun thus frames service before sanction.

topics.headline: relative worker subset before conditional warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the worker-identifying pronoun from the later sanction-triggering pronoun.
topics.reason: The first man follows a partitive phrase and heads a relative clause, whereas the second man governs a conditional protasis and apodosis.

words.gloss_range: ongoing objectless Form I labor under class and permission frames
words.root_gloss_range: doing/craft/work field applied to hidden workers under authorization
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْمَلُ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalu}}) presents ongoing or habitual work with an implicit subject from the relative pronoun. Its Form I simplicity keeps the action direct, while the lack of a stated object foregrounds the labor relation, location, and authorization before 34:13 names products.

topics.headline: ongoing labor before product list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first establishes authorized labor, then lets the next ayah specify outputs.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb, objectless valency, and surrounding class/permission frames support a standing labor arrangement rather than a completed artifact scene.

words.gloss_range: adverbial presence formula placing labor before Sulayman
words.root_gloss_range: between/clarity field locally functioning as supervised presence
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) governs the suffixed dual-hands phrase to form the presence idiom before him. The b-y-n field of separation and clarity fits the scene: hidden workers are located in a distinguishable supervised zone, and the ayah lets spatial grammar carry oversight before adding divine authorization.

topics.headline: presence formula for supervised labor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees supervision carried by location: the work happens before Sulayman, then under divine permission.
topics.reason: The bayna-yadayhi construction is a recognized presence formula and locally separates supervision from authorization.

words.gloss_range: dual suffixed hands completing the presence/authority idiom
words.root_gloss_range: hand/control field idiomatically narrowed to presence before authority
words.prose: {{ar:يَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:yadayhi}}) completes the idiom rather than merely reporting anatomy. The dual with Sulayman's suffix keeps him present as supervisory center, but the following permission phrase immediately reroutes enabling authority beyond his hands.

topics.headline: hands idiom centers supervision, not ultimate source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes Sulayman’s visible supervision from the divine authorization that actually enables the labor.
topics.reason: The dual suffixed noun completes a conventional presence idiom, while the permission phrase prevents an overreading of independent sovereignty.

words.gloss_range: instrumental/causal bāʾ attaching labor to permission
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes permission the basis of the work scene. It attaches the labor syntactically to authorization, so being before Sulayman is not enough; the work proceeds by leave granted through permission.

topics.headline: permission as operative basis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the jinn’s agency is grammatically dependent on authorization, not merely supervised presence.
topics.reason: The preposition qualifies the preceding work scene with instrumental or causal permission.

words.gloss_range: construct verbal noun naming permission as standing authorization
words.root_gloss_range: hearing/notice/permission field selected as granted authorization
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) is a verbal noun in construct: permission is the standing condition of labor, not a one-time narrated speech. Its hearing-to-permission field makes the workers responsive to sanctioned leave, and it pairs with the command phrase so entry into service and breach of service are both governed.

topics.headline: permission brackets authorized labor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the service system bracketed by permission at entry and command at breach.
topics.reason: The bi-governed construct phrase grounds labor in authorization and later pairs with the command boundary.

words.gloss_range: construct Lordship as source of permission, not decorative title
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِۦ}} ({{tr:rabbihi}}) completes the permission chain. Whether the suffix is read with Sulayman or each worker, authorization is grounded in Lordship; the r-b-b field makes that source sustaining governance, not merely rank, and it interrupts the Sulayman-centered scene with higher authority.

topics.headline: Lordship as authorization source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permission comes from sustaining divine governance even inside a scene centered on Sulayman.
topics.reason: The construct complement supplies the source of idhn, and either suffix reference keeps permission under Lordship rather than independent human command.

words.gloss_range: resumptive coordinator pivoting from grant catalog to liability condition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the warning as part of the same movement. The connector no longer adds another gift; it turns enabled labor into regulated labor by pivoting from service to liability without breaking the catalog's rhythm.

topics.headline: grant rhythm turns to liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears sanction as internal to the grant system, not an unrelated afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction resumes with a conditional clause that limits the preceding empowerment frame.

words.gloss_range: conditional whoever forming individual breach-result rule
words.prose: The second {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) is conditional. It governs the swerving verb and the tasting verb, so any individual who swerves is bound directly to the result; the lack of an overt fa spacer makes breach and punishment feel syntactically immediate.

topics.headline: individual liability condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the catalog become a rule: any individual deviator is singled out for consequence.
topics.reason: The conditional pronoun governs the jussive protasis and apodosis, distributing liability over individual offenders.

words.gloss_range: jussive Form I swerving away from command, not generic disobedience
words.root_gloss_range: inclining/swerving field selected for operational deviation from a command line
words.prose: {{ar:يَزِغْ}} ({{tr:yazigh}}) pictures breach as a swerve from a line rather than generic disobedience. The jussive form is locked to the conditional, and Form I keeps responsibility on the offender; variant causative pressure is useful contrast, but the surface makes the worker the one who deviates from command rather than one made to deviate.

topics.headline: self-swerving from command line
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees disobedience spatially, as an accountable movement off the command line.
topics.reason: The conditional jussive surface, Form I value, and ʿan-amr frame support self-swerving; non-canonical causative readings only qualify the contrast.

words.gloss_range: partitive pronoun keeping the offender inside the jinn workforce
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) anchors the possible offender within the previously named group. The plural suffix supplies the workforce, while singular conditional and object pronouns isolate the liable member; the warning is internal to the service system, not a floating maxim.

topics.headline: offender drawn from the workforce
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices liability move from the collective workforce to an accountable individual within it.
topics.reason: The min plus 3MP suffix refers back to the jinn group and narrows the conditional subject to one from them.

words.gloss_range: separation preposition making command the line departed from
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) specifies the direction of the swerve: away from the command phrase. The preposition turns the command into a line or axis of departure, so the breach is not a mere mistake inside obedience but movement off the governed boundary.

topics.headline: departure from command axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the moral breach as departure from a defined command axis.
topics.reason: The verb-preposition frame binds swerving to a governed source of departure, here the divine command.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural command/affair as divine boundary of service
words.root_gloss_range: command/affair field compressed into actionable divine boundary
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرِنَا}} ({{tr:amrinā}}) names the violated boundary in the divine speaker's voice. The 1CP suffix contrasts with Sulayman's supervision, and the broad amr range lets the word mean more than a single order: it is the commanded affair and line of service from which swerving departs. Its pairing with the permission term brackets the system from permission to breach.

topics.headline: divine command as service boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that labor is authorized by permission but limited by a divine command boundary.
topics.reason: The construct noun with first-person suffix names the command line and commanded affair, while the surrounding idhn and yazigh frames define its role in liability.

words.gloss_range: Form IV jussive caused tasting of punishment by divine speaker
words.root_gloss_range: taste/direct-experience field selected as imposed punitive exposure
words.prose: {{ar:نُذِقْهُ}} ({{tr:nudhiqhu}}) returns enforcement to the divine speaker. As the jussive apodosis of the condition, Form IV makes God cause the offender to taste the result; the 3MS object suffix personalizes the exposure, and the taste image turns sanction into direct bodily encounter rather than abstract penalty.

topics.headline: direct tasted sanction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the punishment as imposed experience on an individual offender, not a detached legal statement.
topics.reason: The jussive apodosis, Form IV causative, first-person plural subject, and object suffix all support imposed individual tasting.

words.gloss_range: source/partitive preposition specifying tasted punishment as drawn exposure
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) completes the tasting verb by naming the source-domain from which the exposure comes. The tasted penalty is drawn from punishment, or a portion from it, without pretending the phrase exhausts the whole blaze reality.

topics.headline: tasting drawn from punishment domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sensory logic: tasting samples from a punitive source rather than receiving an undefined threat.
topics.reason: The preposition before the punishment noun can mark source or portion and is governed by the causative tasting frame.

words.gloss_range: construct punishment domain specified by the blaze
words.root_gloss_range: punishment/torment field with sweetness background inverted under taste
words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابِ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābi}}) names the domain from which the tasting is drawn and governs the blaze term in construct, specifying the punishment by its fiery source or character. The broader ʿ-dh-b field can touch sweetness and freshness, but beside the tasting verb and before the blaze it is inverted into painful punitive experience, a field of torment rather than mild correction.

topics.headline: punishment field specified by blaze
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the taste image turn toward a specified punishment domain that prepares the final blaze.
topics.reason: The construct relation and taste collocation select punitive torment; sweetness/freshness background survives only as inverted contrast, not as local sense.

words.gloss_range: definite kindled blaze as final punitive landing
words.root_gloss_range: kindled/intense blaze field, not generic fire
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّعِيرِ}} ({{tr:al-saʿīri}}) is the ayah's final landing. Definite and genitive after the punishment term, it names a recognized punitive fire-domain; the s-ʿ-r field and faʿīl pattern give active, kindled intensity rather than neutral fire. The verse opens with controlled air and closes with kindled blaze, so empowerment ends under the consequence of deviation.

topics.headline: final known blaze domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah land not on empowerment but on a known, active blaze that answers deviation.
topics.reason: The definite genitive, lexical field, pattern value, and final position all support a specialized punitive blaze rather than a generic fire image.

baseline_models.mechanism: Wind is organized into two equal, named legs: morning departure and evening return, each measured as a month. Atmospheric force therefore becomes a scheduled bidirectional transport cycle rather than undirected speed.

activation_trace.role: Wind and moving air supply the mobile medium of the cycle.
Evening travel and return give the second leg its temporal and directional closure.
Morning departure fixes the first leg at the opening of the day.
The repeated known month supplies equal quantitative range to both legs.

changed_reading.before: A spectacularly fast wind makes two long trips.
changed_reading.after: The wording encodes a measured alternating mobility regime whose outward and return legs are synchronized as equal month-range movements.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative flow, a spring-like source, molten copper, and labor before the ruler form a source-to-workshop chain. Hidden agents become materially legible through ordered production.

activation_trace.role: Running flow supplies the process that makes the material continuously available.
A flowing spring supplies a concentrated source rather than scattered material.
Molten copper identifies the supplied stream as workable metal.
Hidden beings provide the otherwise unseen laboring agents.
Intentional work converts supplied material into purposeful production.
The before-hands construction places production in a supervised presence.

changed_reading.before: A copper spring and a jinn workforce are two separate favors.
changed_reading.after: They read as one integrated foundry: a supplied liquid-metal source passes into supervised hidden labor and manifest output.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Authority is nested: Solomon benefits from service, but the Lord licenses it, the divine command defines its path, and deviation activates embodied sanction. The grant is delegated governance, not autonomous sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Permission and licensing bound every subordinate act.
Lordship supplies the superior ownership and sovereignty behind the grant.
Deviation is a directional departure from an established straight course.
Binding command supplies the norm from which a worker can depart.
Tasting turns breach into personally experienced consequence.
Punitive pain gives the sanction its judicial force.
Kindled blaze supplies the sanction's consuming material image.

changed_reading.before: Solomon commands a coerced workforce by exceptional personal power.
changed_reading.after: His command space exists only inside divine license, and each worker remains individually answerable to the higher command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَمَن يَزِغْ نُذِقْهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus repeatedly externalizes what is concealed: hidden beings work in front, an eye/source emits visible metal, and invisible deviation becomes tasted consequence.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the hidden pole of the scene.
The eye branch supplies an exploratory image of visibility within the material source.
Being before the hands places concealed labor in an exposed relational field.
Experienced tasting makes an otherwise abstract breach bodily legible.

changed_reading.before: Unseen servants simply perform assigned tasks.
changed_reading.after: The scene is also a disclosure apparatus: hidden agency becomes knowable through visible work, position before authority, and embodied consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired motions of 34:2, entry and exit from earth and descent and ascent through heaven, activate a circulation grammar around the focus. Its morning/evening wind and flowing metal become horizontal and material channels inside a larger ordered field of movement known by God.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the inward vector of the circulation pair.
Passage outward supplies the balancing exit vector.
Descent supplies the downward vertical channel.
Ascent supplies the upward return channel.
The focus's flowing metal realizes ordered circulation in a material register.

structural_cues: 34:2 balances entry with exit and descent with ascent; 34:12 balances morning with evening and couples transit to material flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two balanced motion lists; I infer a shared circulation grammar. A live alternative is that the symmetry is rhetorical and does not imply one integrated system.

changed_reading.before: The wind is an isolated vehicle and the copper an isolated material miracle.
changed_reading.after: Both participate in a measured circulation system whose directional flows remain inside divine knowledge and ordering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated uses of the before-hands construction span surrounding space, textual precedence, and impending punishment. This widens the jinn's position before Solomon from court placement into an exposed horizon where prior order and coming consequence are both present.

activation_trace.role: The focus locates labor directly before an authority.
The interval between hands and behind forms a surrounding field open to inspection.
What lies before the hands supplies the visible forward field.
What lies behind completes the spatial enclosure around the observer.
The same construction extends forward presence into textual precedence.
A punishment before the hands extends the construction into imminence.

structural_cues: The construction occurs at 34:9, 34:12, 34:31, and 34:46 with spatial, textual, and anticipatory scopes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction; I infer resonance across its scopes. A live alternative is that each occurrence is a conventional idiom with no designed cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: The jinn merely work physically in front of Solomon.
changed_reading.after: Their work occurs in an accountability horizon: exposed before authority, continuous with prior order, and facing consequence already set before them.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's hard iron is softened and then constrained by measured, connected fabrication; Solomon's copper is liquefied and hidden workers are constrained by permission and command. The paired sequence is enable material, calibrate process, and inspect work.

activation_trace.role: Softness against rough resistance supplies the enabling material transformation.
Hard iron supplies the resistant material made workable.
Deliberate estimation supplies process planning and calibrated limits.
Connected succession supplies an ordered fabrication pattern.
Repeated intentional work joins craft instruction, moral output, and inspection.
Molten copper supplies Solomon's parallel transformation of resistant matter.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 immediately precedes 34:12; each gift alters a metal and immediately binds making to ordered work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies juxtaposed metal transformations and work clauses; I infer a shared craft-governance pattern. They can still remain separate gifts rather than one technical program.

changed_reading.before: Flowing copper is primarily a display of abundance.
changed_reading.after: It is the feedstock side of calibrated craft governance, paired with softened iron and bounded by measured process, authorization, and inspected work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next scene converts generic work into durable public-scale objects and then names the required human work as gratitude. Saba's provision-and-thanks formula confirms that productive abundance seeks an ethical return, not output alone.

activation_trace.role: Repeated intentional work links jinn production to the command addressed to David's household.
Fixed, rooted cauldrons turn mobile material into stable infrastructure.
Recognition of the benefaction names the proper moral product of work.
Allocated provision places abundance inside a giver-recipient relation.
The repeated demand for gratitude generalizes the response owed for provision.
The focus's binding command anchors gratitude back in obedient production.

structural_cues: 34:13 follows the focus with a product list and the imperative to work as gratitude; 34:15 repeats provision followed by gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies neighboring work and gratitude imperatives; I infer that material obedience is meant to become grateful service. A live alternative is that the ethical command applies only to David's household and frames, rather than defines, jinn labor.

changed_reading.before: The command keeps an extraordinary workforce productive.
changed_reading.after: The production system is ethically incomplete until mobile gifts settle into useful stability and their beneficiaries answer abundance with grateful work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solomon's death is not indicated until a creeping creature consumes the support and his fall discloses the truth. The hidden workers then prove unable to know the hidden. Their extraordinary status is therefore sharply separated from access to unseen knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies hidden beings as the commanded workforce.
Indication by a sign supplies the missing disclosure of death.
Loss of life creates the concealed state that the workers fail to detect.
Creeping on earth supplies the small material agent that erodes the support.
The audible, unstable fall converts concealed death into public evidence.
The same hidden beings become the subjects of epistemic exposure.
Disclosure to a knower marks the knowledge they demonstrably lacked.
What is screened from eyes defines the domain denied to the jinn.

structural_cues: 34:14 gives a causal sequence: concealed death, unnoticed erosion, fall, disclosure, and the counterfactual denial of jinn knowledge of the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence; I infer that Solomon's visible standing mediated labor discipline while divine permission sustained the hierarchy. A live alternative is that the verse only denies jinn knowledge without explaining the mechanism of continued labor.

changed_reading.before: Command over jinn displays mastery of the unseen.
changed_reading.after: The workforce is itself demystified: hidden agents can be organized visibly while remaining ignorant of the unseen and dependent on a higher authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same flow root that supplies molten copper returns as Saba's flood after the command to give thanks is refused. A restrained channel becomes a landscape-replacing force, making flow a governed threshold between productive release and destructive release.

activation_trace.role: The causatively released flow feeds productive metalwork in the focus.
Grateful recognition supplies the ethical condition immediately before the reversal.
Turning one's side away supplies the relational switch preceding destructive flow.
The repeated root now realizes flow as an overwhelming flood.
A barrier that holds back floodwater supplies the image of breached restraint.
One thing replacing another supplies the flood's irreversible material consequence.

structural_cues: 34:15 offers provision and gratitude; 34:16 answers turning away with a flood and substituted gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated flow root and the ethical sequence; I infer a controlled-versus-destructive release contrast. It may remain a narrative analogy rather than a direct hydraulic gloss on the copper.

changed_reading.before: Flowing copper is an unqualified image of abundance.
changed_reading.after: Flow is beneficial only while channeled within right relation: it can feed craft, or cross its threshold and replace an inhabited abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured safe routes in 34:18 become deliberately distanced journeys and then fragmentation in 34:19. Against that reversal, Solomon's month-range morning and evening transit reads as bestowed calibration of distance, not conquest of distance for its own sake.

activation_trace.role: Evening travel and return anchor one half of the focus's compressed itinerary.
Repeated months quantify the granted reach of each daily leg.
Deliberate estimation organizes the route into a planned travel system.
Movement and onward travel supply the safely enabled circulation.
Actively producing distance reverses the prior convenience of measured routes.
Travel away from settlement makes the requested distancing operational.
Tearing into scattered pieces gives misused distance its social endpoint.

structural_cues: 34:18 links measured routes to secure night-and-day travel; 34:19 requests greater distance and ends in total dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a calibrated route followed by requested distance and fragmentation; I infer that the focus's compressed itinerary is a permissioned good. A live alternative is that Solomon's wind and Saba's roads are independent travel motifs.

changed_reading.before: The wind simply annihilates ordinary travel time.
changed_reading.after: Its speed is a form of rightly measured access: distance serves circulation when granted and becomes fragmentation when desired as estrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Satan has no governing authority except within a divine test; alleged powers own not even an atom, possess no share, and intercession works only by permission. These denials sharpen the focus's repeated for-him language into allocation and use rather than independent ownership.

activation_trace.role: The focus explicitly licenses the labor instead of locating authority in Solomon alone.
Lordship anchors ultimate ownership above the delegated beneficiary.
Capacity and governing authority are explicitly denied as an independent possession.
Ownership and disposal are denied to claimed subordinate powers.
Weight and measure reduce the denied ownership to the smallest accountable scale.
The minute scattered particle marks how exhaustive the ownership denial is.
Partnership and shared title are explicitly excluded.
Permission returns as the sole gate even for intercession.

structural_cues: 34:21-23 repeatedly deny independent authority, ownership, partnership, and support, then preserve permission as the governing exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies categorical denials and a repeated permission clause; I infer that for Solomon marks entrusted benefit or use. Grammatically it could mark benefit alone without specifying a legal theory of usufruct.

changed_reading.before: Wind, copper, and jinn constitute Solomon's extraordinary possessions.
changed_reading.after: They are allocated capacities held inside divine title: real delegation without any transfer of ultimate ownership or independent power.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the later exposure of jinn as objects of false worship, 34:42 denies every party ownership of benefit or harm and repeats the command to taste punishment. The focus's immediate labor sanction becomes a local-scale enactment of the surah's wider accountability rule.

activation_trace.role: Experienced tasting makes the focus sanction immediate and personal.
The kindled blaze supplies the focus's local punitive image.
Hidden beings reappear as wrongly worshiped agents rather than rightful owners of power.
The denial of ownership removes every creature's independent control over outcome.
Benefit opposed to harm names the outcomes no party can independently confer.
The exact experiential punishment idiom repeats at collective judgment.
Punitive pain carries the focus sanction into the later judgment scene.

structural_cues: 34:41 names jinn worship; 34:42 immediately denies creaturely control and repeats tasting punishment by fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the jinn sequence and verbal recurrence; I infer that the focus sanction previews the universal judgment pattern. It could instead be a standard punishment formula repeated without typological force.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is a workplace disciplinary threat peculiar to Solomon's jinn.
changed_reading.after: It is also a focused preview of the surah's anti-idolatry judgment: delegated agents cannot own outcomes, and deviation becomes experienced accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the lexical phrase uses eye as a spring, not as a direct claim that the copper source watches. It remains anchored in the packet's attested eye branch, labor before the hands, and the adjacent declaration that work is seen. Downstream prose should present it as a material-metaphoric overlay, never as an alternate translation of the phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ

activation_trace.role: The spring branch fixes eye as the literal source feeding the foundry.
The bodily eye branch supplies a secondary visibility image within that source.
Work before the hands places production in an exposed supervisory field.
The immediately preceding assertion of seeing work activates inspection around the focus workshop.

changed_reading.before: The molten-metal source feeds a supervised workshop.
changed_reading.after: As a contained overlay, the workshop is also an inspection field: the eye/source, labor before authority, and divine seeing make production legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus verb is causative flow, while request comes from the packet's explicit secondary mapped root. The split-root activation is still anchored in the supplied inventory and sharpened by the later refusal to ask a wage. Downstream prose must call it an echo of provision or fulfilled need, not parse or translate the focus verb as asking.

activation_trace.role: The secondary mapped branch supplies the image of a need or request being fulfilled beneath the dominant flow sense.
The later refusal to ask anything from the audience sharpens the contrast between grant and extraction.
Payment for work supplies the wage that the messenger explicitly does not demand.

changed_reading.before: God makes a copper source flow for Solomon.
changed_reading.after: As a split-root echo only, the flow also resembles a need fulfilled for him, set against a later mission that extracts no wage from its hearers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it connects physical transport to the closing scenes of failed eschatological reach. It remains anchored in the focus's quantified morning/evening transit and the packet's repeated near, far, reaching, and barrier language. Downstream prose should describe a surah-level contrast in access, not identify wind travel with salvation.

activation_trace.role: Evening travel and return supply successful long-range movement inside a granted cycle.
Month units quantify the extraordinary reach achieved in each daily leg.
Failure of attainment or escape supplies the closing negation of reach.
Nearness becomes the location of seizure rather than an advantage.
Reaching by extension names the access sought too late.
Farness makes the desired reach unavailable.
An intervening barrier finally blocks access to what is desired.

changed_reading.before: Miraculous speed collapses distance for Solomon.
changed_reading.after: Distance collapses only under granted access; without it, reaching from far fails, nearness becomes seizure, and a barrier closes the desired path.

strongest_changes: The focus shifted from three adjacent marvels into a calibrated circulation, foundry, and command system.
The David and Saba sequences made material flow ethically conditional: measured craft and gratitude stabilize abundance, while turning away releases destructive flow.
Solomon's for-him privileges became allocated capacities bounded by permission, with no transfer of ultimate ownership.
The jinn sequence demystified hidden agency by separating visible service from knowledge of the unseen.
Travel became permissioned reachability rather than raw speed: measured access sustains circulation, while desired distance can end in dispersal or failed reach.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence joined flow, work, measurement, before-hands exposure, permission, distance, and tasting into one unusually inspectable mechanism: material engineering and mobility are real powers, but each remains morally, epistemically, and juridically bounded. The packet's split mapping of the flow root also preserved a contained fulfilled-request outlier that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated before-hands construction may form a deliberate spatial-temporal chain, or its occurrences may remain independent idioms.
The controlled copper flow and Saba flood strongly reverse one another at the root level, but the degree of intended hydraulic analogy remains uncertain.
The eye/source and fulfilled-request readings are branch-backed overlays, not alternate lexical translations, and should remain explicitly qualified.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Rule is a controlled flow network.** `ر و ح/B003` is moving air, `ر و ح/B008` alternation and turns, `س ي ل/B001` flowing water, and `ع م ل/B003` holding an official charge. Morning/evening measures alternate air; molten material then flows; charged workers operate before the ruler by permission. Air, metal, and labor become three managed flows. The packet supplies their sequence and authorization; I infer that permission is the valve aligning them. The ayah reads dominion as calibrated circulation rather than possession alone.
2. **Deviation is a flow leaving alignment.** `ز ي غ/B001` (turning aside) is structurally opposed to work “before his hands” and under command. I assign it the role of lateral leakage from the authorized network; the punishment-arrow is explicit in the packet, while the hydraulic analogy is inferred. The warning reads as system failure through misalignment, not merely personal disobedience.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:14 corrected the jinn-work system by showing that authorized labor does not imply unseen knowledge; 34:39 later preserved the flow model without hierarchy or coercion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Rule as metered circulation.** `ر و ح B008` supplies alternation and taking turns, `ش ه ر B001` a month made known by a visible crescent, and `ق ط ر B004` ordered succession alongside `ق ط ر B006`, molten copper. Morning and evening travel are symmetrically measured, then copper is made to flow. The branches assign rule the role of regulating cycles in time and matter. The packet supplies equal temporal spans and material flow; I infer that their coordination forms an administered circulation system. The wonders read as measured transport and production rather than disconnected spectacles.

2. **A source designed for collection.** `ع ي ن B006` supplies a springing water-eye and `س ي ل B001` a flowing torrent. Though the substance is molten copper, 34:13 immediately supplies basins and anchored cauldrons. The branches make `عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ` a source mouth whose output requires downstream capture. The packet supplies the flow and vessels; I infer a source-to-collection relation. The copper spring therefore reads as the head of an infrastructure, not merely an isolated abundance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:13 supplied the decisive downstream surprise: basin-like bowls and fixed cauldrons reveal where a flowing copper-eye can be collected and transformed. That later catalog confirmed the source-to-infrastructure reading rather than leaving `عَيْنَ` as isolated spectacle.

baseline.text: Süleyman'ın hizmetine de rüzgârı verdik; sabah gidişi bir ay, akşam dönüşü bir aydı. Onun için erimiş bakır kaynağını akıttık. Cinlerden de Rabbinin izniyle önünde çalışanlar vardı. Onlardan kim buyruğumuzdan saparsa ona alevli ateş azabını tattırırız.

findings.text: Hükümranlık, zaman içindeki rüzgârı, akan bakırı ve yetkilendirilmiş emeği ölçülü tek bir dolaşım düzeninde birleştirir.
Erimiş bakır kaynağı, sonraki büyük kaplarda toplanıp işlenecek üretim akışının başlangıç ağzı olarak görünür.
Buyruktan sapma, yetkilendirilmiş dolaşım ağından yana doğru sızan ve sistemin hizasını bozan bir akış gibi okunabilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Responsive Media Turn Command Into Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Favor and command become visible by making unlike media responsive: bodies return in chorus, metal yields to joining, wind obeys a schedule, molten matter flows, and built vessels hold their assigned form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Landscape, animal movement, transport, metallurgy, hidden labor, and monumental craft are coordinated as different material responses to directed agency.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Transport Calibrated by Recurrence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wind-borne movement is divided into morning and return phases, each assigned the same monthly measure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wind as moving medium (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`), morning departure (`quranic:root_001076:B001/m01`), evening return (`quranic:root_000609:B005/m01`), calendrical month (`quranic:root_000823:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Extraordinary speed is expressed through recurrence and equal allotment. Movement becomes dependable because departure and return are both measured.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Molten Source and Licensed Hidden Labor
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A metallic source is made to flow while concealed workers operate under permission and remain liable for deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: released flow (`quranic:root_000770:B001/m01`), flowing source (`quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`), molten copper (`quranic:root_001238:B006/m01`), concealed beings (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`), licensed action (`quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`), deviation from course (`quranic:root_000658:B001/m01`)

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bedene canlılık veren iç varlık çerçevesi kaynak ifadesinin ana eksenini karşılar. Ancak kaynaklar bu varlığı kişinin özüyle özdeş sayma ya da ondan ayrı görme konusunda ayrıldığı için tanım bu görüş ayrılığını açıkça korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal insan bedeninin yaşam ilkesidir; kutsal varlık adları, yel, koku ve dinlenme anlamları kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim insan bedenine canlılık veren iç varlığı anlatır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar bu tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsan bedenini canlı tutan ve bedenden ayrılması yaşamın bitmesi sayılan iç varlıktır. Kaynakların bir bölümü bunu kişinin özüyle aynı, bir bölümü ise ondan ayrı kabul eder.

facets.statement: İç varlık bedene canlılık verir ve onun ayrılması beden yaşamının sona ermesini bildirir.
Bu iç varlığın kişinin özüyle aynı mı yoksa ondan ayrı mı olduğu konusunda iki görüş vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bedeni canlı tutan ve ölümde bedenden ayrılan bir iç varlıkta birleşir; bunun kişinin özüyle ilişkisini ise iki farklı biçimde açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan bedenindeki yaşam ilkesini ve onun bedenden ayrılışını birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedene canlılık verme, iç varlık olma ve ölümde ayrılma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İç varlığın bedenden ayrılmasıyla kişinin öldüğünü bildiren bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedenden ayrılma ile yaşamın sona ermesi arasındaki bağı korur.
error_profile.loses: İç varlığın niteliğini ve kişinin özüyle ilişkisine dair görüş ayrılığını vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bedene yaşam veren ve ölümde ayrılan iç varlık

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bedeni canlı tutan iç varlığı ve onun ölümde bedenden ayrılmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Canlı özün yanında kişinin kendisini ve tek tek insanları da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yaşam veren iç varlık ile canlı öz
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de insanın canlılığını taşıyan görünmez iç yönü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedensel yaşamı sağlayan iç varlıkla sınırlıdır ve bu varlığın kişinin özüyle aynı olup olmadığı tartışmasını korur. Komşu dal ise canlı özü kişinin kendisine kadar genişletebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; insanın canlı özüyle ilgili komşu en yakın karışma alanını verdi, öteki adaylar ise beden, son nefes, yel, koku veya aynı kökün uzak anlamlarında kaldı.
